question: Two trains of equal length are running on parallel lines in the same direction at speeds of 36 km/h and 26 km/h. The faster train passes the slower train in 18 seconds. The length of each train is:
solution:
**Given:**

The speed of two equal trains is 36 km/h and 26 km/h.

Time = 18 sec

**Formula used:**

Length of train = speed × time

Relative speed in the same direction is subtracted.
